claims.exact_statement: O'Farrell and Raj report that trained primary human macrophages produce gene-specific single-cell RNA-FISH response changes after restimulation, with early trained advantages and later untrained catch-up; the companion source reports measurements across 90,857 cells and 26 donors.
assumptions: limited to source-reported claims and study conditions
no independent cell-level table analysis performed
claims.status: source-reported; not independently validated in this lane
claims.novelty_boundary: Existing 2026 primary-study result; not a C13 discovery.
costs: RNA-FISH across 90,857 measured cells, four genes, and 26 donors according to source
kinetic time course in the shared-data README covers two donors
claims.falsifier: Source-correct reanalysis or a matched independent experiment fails to recover donor-blocked early trained differences and later catch-up.
claims.next_gate: Acquire processed cell rows; estimate independent sample counts; test held-out distribution prediction after covariate and mixture adjustment.

claims.exact_statement: A common donor-specific monotone response-time map across genes is a candidate falsifiable model for the early-trained/late-catch-up pattern; no evidence for this model has been acquired or analyzed.
assumptions: cross-sectional single-cell spot-count distributions are the target
the released-data schema and donor/time availability match Dryad README
time maps and alternative models would be prespecified
claims.status: prospective model contrast only; not a theorem, fitted model, or scientific advance
claims.novelty_boundary: Generic response-time warping is not claimed novel; the potential capability would be a donor-held-out, full-distribution predictive interface if it materially outperforms equally informed static, gene-specific, and mixture baselines.
costs: processed data and scripts not obtained
future analysis must count donors/independent samples rather than cells as replication
imaging, probes, cell counts, time points, and compute must be charged
claims.falsifier: No donor-blocked held-out predictive gain, or the gain disappears after donor/date, density, morphology, and mixture adjustment.
claims.next_gate: Resolve legitimate data access and reconstruct exact sample structure before fitting.

overall_verdict: C12 is preserved. C13 contains a fresh 2026 primary-source lead and partial data-interface reconstruction only. The processed measurement bytes could not be acquired anonymously; no C13 theorem, biological discovery, prediction, or control capability is established.
